Welcome

Welcome to The Walkerton Livery

We offer a clean, freshly remodeled place to stay with affordable rates. The Livery is located a half block off of main street in Walkerton, Ontario. Email us at frontdesk@walkertonlivery.ca with any questions.

Our story →

Trades people welcome

With so much construction activity in the region, we are geared to serve those working on short term contracts or projects who need a place to stay while in the area.

30 minutes to Bruce Power

The Livery is about a 30 minute drive from Bruce Power, with free parking at the building.

Keyless check-in

Your door code arrives automatically after you book. Check-in from 2:00 pm, check-out by 11:00 am.

In every room

Everything you need, nothing you don't.

  • Individually air-conditioned
  • Free fibre optic Wi-Fi
  • Internet television
  • Coffee maker
  • Mini fridge & microwave
  • Private bathroom
  • USB & network connections
  • Free parking

How check-in works

Book, get your code, walk in.

Check-in2:00 pm
Check-out11:00 am

  1. Book online

    Pick your dates and room at book.walkertonlivery.ca. Rates are live and booking is instant.

  2. Get your door code

    Our booking system sends your personal door code automatically before you arrive. No key pickup, no front desk to wait for.

  3. Let yourself in

    Enter your code at the smart lock and you're in. Your code works for your stay only.
